title: 茶水间英文 - 11月21日 | 股市大跳水、八年飞抵水星、ＢＴＳ横扫
description:
Wall Street just had a brutal Friday, with the S and P and the Dow sliding into correction territory and the Nasdaq wiping out all of its gains for the year, while Anthropic gave back most of its huge I P O pop on day two. Meanwhile, after eight years in space, the European and Japanese spacecraft BepiColombo is finally parking around Mercury today, and B T S just swept the M A M A Awards in Osaka without even showing up. Plus a random question: if you could bring one extinct animal back as a pet, which one would you pick?

周五美股遭遇重挫，标普和道指双双跌入修正区间，纳斯达克抹去全年涨幅，Anthropic 上市第二天也吐回了大部分涨幅。与此同时，欧日联合探测器 BepiColombo 经过八年飞行，终于在今天进入水星轨道；BTS 则人不到场，照样在大阪 MAMA 颁奖礼上横扫五项大奖。今天还有一个随机问题：如果能让一种灭绝动物复活当宠物，你会选哪种？

Words to steal 生词本：
- correction territory — 修正区间；较近期高点下跌超10%
- wipe out — 抹去；一扫而空
- roller coaster — 过山车；大起大落
- gravity assist — 引力助推；借力飞行
- hit the brakes — 踩刹车；减速
- sweep — 横扫；包揽（奖项）
- grand prize — 大奖；最高奖项
